material.acceptance_criteria: Live witness: a browser room runs N ticks, writes a snapshot; the host page is reloaded or the room is torn down and re-created from storage; a reconnecting wireweave peer receives a state frame whose state_hash equals the pre-restart hash, and the tick resumes from snapshot.tick. A missing or corrupt snapshot yields an explicit refusal line, never a silent empty room.
material.description: The Node host is retired (commit 68a30ad; docs/HOST.md). The supported host is the browser host over wireweave (WebRTC + Nostr), GitHub Pages target. Rescope: a room hosted in the browser persists its state snapshot (tick, state_hash, state bytes) at a checkpoint, and when the host restarts it restores from the last good snapshot, so a reconnecting peer receives a state frame whose state_hash equals the pre-restart hash. Existing building block: rust/crates/server/src/room.rs:210 Room::snapshot and Snapshot{tick,state_hash} at room.rs:62; sim save_state/load_state exist (rust/gate/src/sim_checks.rs:551) but are not exposed by rust/crates/web Game. blocked_by: gap-net-host-resume-blocker-gm-orch-2-9-r2 (committed wasm pkg is stale, BadVersion(15) on the current image; wasm32 target not installable here).
material.resolution: verifier gm-orch-2-9-v1 at d045f92: build-once restore step passes (RESULT: PASS snapshot state_hash match, job 117498429385, run 39067607539 success); startHost restores and saves snapshots (play.js:434-442); save_state/load_state exported (lib.rs:36,41).

material.witness_plan: Browser witness over the real wireweave host page, gpu-free where the module graph answers it (snapshot encode/decode and restore round-trip against the real modules), one browser arm for the live reconnect. Print RESULT: PASS|FAIL|REFUSED with the two hashes; exit non-zero on mismatch.
